info.title: Logbook API
info.summary: Read a Logbook garage and log fill-ups, odometer readings, trips, service records, documents, expenses, tread checks and manual reminders.
info.description: Quantities are canonical (km, litres or kWh, L/100 km or kWh/100 km) decimal strings; money is in the vehicle's currency; instants are UTC. Amount fields are left out, not zeroed, for vehicles whose costs the key's user may not see. See docs/api.md for keys, paging, errors and worked examples.

servers.description: Replaced by this install's address when served

get.summary: The key's user, the key and the modules
Vehicles the key's user can see

get.description: Current odometer, economy per series, last fill-up, 12-month cost per distance, what is due next, reminder counts, current documents and tyres, and the same figures as text in the owner's units.

post.description: Needs a read and write key. Validated as the form validates. An entry with the same time and odometer as an existing one is not written again: the existing one comes back with duplicate true.
Needs a read and write key. A reading with the same time and odometer as any existing one (whatever wrote it) is not written again.
Needs a read and write key and Log. The maintenance module must be on. A record with the same date, category, title and cost (the CSV import's duplicate key) is not written again.
Needs a read and write key and Log. The compliance module must be on. A document with the same type, reference, start and expiry is not written again.

get.description: Needs cost access to the vehicle (403 without).

post.description: Needs a read and write key and Log (cost access is not needed to add one). An expense with the same date, category, amount and note is not written again.

get.summary: Coming up over the next 12 months

get.description: The key user's own trips, or every driver's when they manage or own the vehicle. Needs the trips module.

post.description: Needs a read and write key. Validated as the trip form validates, in km, the whole trip's distance. A trip of the key's user with the same date, places and distance is not written again: it comes back with duplicate true.

get.description: The claim report's figures: the key user's own business trips on every vehicle they can see, valued at their rates. Needs the trips module.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The year the tax year starts in (default: the current tax year).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: custom with from and to for a date range.

get.description: Their saved journeys in their Settings → Trips order, to log one with journey_id on POST /vehicles/{id}/trips. Needs the trips module.

post.description: Needs a read and write key and Log. The tyres module must be on. A check on the same date with the same depth at every position is not written again.
Needs a read and write key and Manage, as on the Reminders page. The reminders module must be on. An open manual reminder with the same title and due date is not written again.

apiKey.description: An API key from Settings → API keys: Authorization: Bearer lbk_…

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: From the previous page's next URL.

since.name: since
since.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD, from its start in UTC) or an instant; inclusive.

until.name: until
until.description: A date (to its end in UTC) or an instant; inclusive.

Unauthorized.description: No key, or a malformed, unknown or revoked one.

Forbidden.description: A read key on a write (insufficient_scope), or the key's user may see the vehicle but not do this.

NotFound.description: No such vehicle for this key's user, the module is switched off, or the API is (API_ENABLED=false).

BadParameter.description: A query parameter cannot be read (invalid_parameter).

TooMany.description: Too many failed keys from this address; wait Retry-After seconds.

Invalid.description: Validation failed (validation_failed), with errors per field.

BadBody.description: The body is not a JSON object (invalid_body).

Decimal.description: A decimal number as a string at its stored precision, never a float: "10600.000".

Date.description: A calendar date, no time or zone.

code.description: Stable; branch on this, not on the text.

errors.description: Validation only: per field, the form's message key and its English text.

capacity_unit.description: The tank in litres, or the battery in kWh for an EV.

first_inspection_due_on.description: First MOT (or the local equivalent) due; used only while the vehicle has no inspection document.

currency.description: The vehicle's currency: its override, else the owner's.

consumption.description: Litres (kWh) per 100 km over the segment.

Segment.description: The full-to-full segment this fill-up closes.

EconomyCheck.description: The economy check of the segment this fill-up closes (spec §7.3).

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.

currency.description: ISO 4217; every amount in this object is in it. Left out, with the amounts, without cost access.

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.

source_id.description: The fill-up, service record, document or tyre change that wrote it; null for a manual reading.

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.

currency.description: ISO 4217; every amount in this object is in it. Left out, with the amounts, without cost access.

days_left.description: Days until expiry; negative once expired.

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.

currency.description: ISO 4217; every amount in this object is in it. Left out, with the amounts, without cost access.
ISO 4217. Left out, with the amount, only on a write's duplicate that is another user's, without cost access.

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.

depth_now.description: The latest measurement moved on by the wear since.

currency.description: ISO 4217; every amount in this object is in it. Left out, with the amounts, without cost access.

cost_per_distance.description: Money per km over the tyre's life.

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.

projected.description: The date is estimated from the average daily distance.

currency.description: ISO 4217; every amount in this object is in it. Left out, with the amounts, without cost access.

cost.description: Last time's price; null when not known.

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.

EconomySeries.description: One series' economy over every full-to-full segment.

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.

fuel.description: Left out when the Fuel module is off.

costs.description: Running costs over the last 12 months (as Reports counts them); left out without cost access.

reminders.description: Open reminder counts; left out when Reminders is off.

documents.description: Current documents; left out when Compliance is off.

display.description: The figures as text in the key owner's units, language and currency.

FuelInput.description: Give any two of volume, price_per_unit and total_cost; the third is derived.

filled_at.description: Default: now. Send it, so a retry is recognised.

grade.description: Default: the form's (the grade last bought).

volume_unit.description: Default: the owner's, or kWh for electricity.

recorded_at.description: Default: now. Send it, so a retry is recognised.

NumberInput.description: A decimal string or a JSON number; read as a decimal, never a float, with "." as the decimal point.

Trip.description: A logged trip. Distances are in km; distance_km is the whole trip (both ways for a return).

journey.description: "Ballymena → Belfast", or "Ballymena → Belfast → Ballymena" for a return.

created_by.description: The driver's user id; null for a former user.

TripInput.description: Give from, to and either distance_km or both odometers, or a journey_id (a saved journey of the key's user fills from, to, is_return, is_business, purpose and, without distance_km or odometers, the distance: doubled on a return). Fields sent win over the journey's.

travelled_on.description: Default: today in the owner's time zone. Send it, so a retry is recognised.

journey_id.description: One of the key user's saved journeys.

distance_km.description: The whole trip in km, never doubled.

is_business.description: Default: true (or the journey's). A business trip needs a purpose.

ClaimLine.description: Part of a trip's distance at one rate (two lines for a trip that crosses the threshold).

ClaimTrip.description: A business trip at the rates in effect on its date. With no rate set in effect, distance, unit, amounts and currency are null and lines is empty.

ClaimTotals.description: One currency's totals, each a sum of amounts rounded to the minor unit on every line: the rates' amounts add up to mileage_amount, and approved_amount is mileage_amount plus passenger_amount.

employer_amount.description: What the employer paid; null without employer rates.

difference.description: Approved mileage (without passengers) minus the employer's payment: positive is unpaid.

tax_year.description: "2026/27" (or "2026" for a year starting 1 January); null for a custom range.

trips.description: The key user's business trips in the period, oldest first.

unvalued.description: Trips with no rate set in effect on their date.

SavedJourney.description: A saved journey. distance_km is one way; is_return, is_business and purpose are what a trip logged from it starts with.

journey.description: "Ballymena → Belfast", or "Ballymena → Belfast → Ballymena" for a return.

performed_on.description: Default: today in the owner's time zone.

schedule_id.description: One of the vehicle's schedules: the record completes it.

odometer.description: Needs start_on: the reading is written at local noon on it.

spent_on.description: Default: today in the owner's time zone.

checked_on.description: Default: today in the owner's time zone.

depths.description: Fitted position code → depth. A position with no fitted tyre is refused.

ReminderInput.description: At least one of due_on and due_odometer: whichever comes first.

due_odometer.description: The odometer it is due at, in distance_unit.

lead_time_days.description: Default: the owner's manual reminder lead time.

distance_unit.description: Every distance and odometer value in this object is in kilometres.
